rule_text.name: 702.262a
rule_text.rule: Agonize appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents two static abilities: one that functions while the card is in a player’s graveyard and another that functions while the card is on the stack. “Agonize” means “You may cast this card from your graveyard if the resulting spell is an instant or sorcery spell by putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control as an additional cost to cast it” and “If this spell was cast using its agonize ability, exile this card instead of putting it anywhere else any time it would leave the stack.” Casting a spell using its agonize ability follows the rules for paying additional costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

rule_text.name: 702.268a
rule_text.rule: Showcase appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents two abilities: a static ability that functions while the spell with showcase is on the stack and a spell ability. “Showcase [cost]” means “You may pay [cost] rather than pay this spell’s mana cost as you cast this spell” and “If this spell’s showcase cost was paid, exile this card, then create a 1/1 red Bard creature token with “This creature can't block.” Whenever that token attacks, you may copy the exiled card and cast it without paying its mana cost.” Casting a spell using its showcase ability follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.
